annotations.title: Get one allow or block entry

description: Use this when you need one address or domain on an allow or block list. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: direction (required; send, receive, or reply), type (required; allow or block), entry (required; email or domain), inbox_id (optional; omit for the account-wide list). Returns {object:"list_entry", direction, type, entry, entry_type, inbox_id, reason, created_at}. Fails with 400 invalid_list, 400 invalid_entry, 404 list_entry_not_found, or inbox_not_found.

entry.description: Email address or domain, matched case-insensitively.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email. Omit for the account-wide list.

name: cooper_get_list_entry
title: Get one allow or block entry
